faq_heading: Cliff Drive condos and townhomes: your questions answered

faq.q: What did condos and townhomes in Cliff Drive sell for?
faq.a: 19 condos sold in Cliff Drive between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $550,000.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Cliff Drive?
faq.a: The median was 68 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.7% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos and townhomes in Cliff Drive sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 19 condos that sold in Cliff Drive went for between $495,000 and $632,000, around a median of $550,000.

faq.q: Do condos and townhomes in Cliff Drive sell above asking price?
faq.a: 0% of the 19 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.7% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos and townhomes in Cliff Drive?
faq.a: Of the 19 sales, 19 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $560.

faq.q: How old are the condos and townhomes that sold in Cliff Drive?
faq.a: The median year built was 1996 for the 19 condos sold in Cliff Drive.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos and townhomes in Cliff Drive usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Cliff Drive had 2 bedrooms, from the 19 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

blocks.text: Cliff Drive condos and townhomes for sale now
What Cliff Drive condos and townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

19 condos sold in Cliff Drive with a median price of $550,000 (the middle half sold between $495,000 and $632,000), taking a median of 68 days to sell at 96.7% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $516 per square foot, a median year built of 1996 and a median strata fee of $560 a month.

blocks.text: How Cliff Drive compares with the rest of Tsawwassen

The median condo in Cliff Drive sold for $550,000, 6% below the Tsawwassen median of $585,000 across 97 sales. Cliff Drive condos took a median 68 days to sell, against 44 days for Tsawwassen as a whole.
